title: Coursera program
description: Metadata for one Coursera program (a Professional Certificate or Specialization). Lives at content/<program-slug>/program.json.

title.description: Full program name, as on Coursera.

shortTitle.description: Shorter name for tight spaces (search results, breadcrumbs).

provider.description: Who offers it, e.g. Google or University of Michigan.

order.description: Position on the home page. Lower comes first.

status.description: Your own status for the program.

courses.description: Every course in the program, in order. Course N matches the folder whose name starts with the number N (e.g. 01-...).

optional.description: Marks an optional course. It is left out of progress totals.

modules.description: Module titles in order. Optional; modules you have notes for show up even if they are not listed here.
